purpose: state plainly what has and has not been verified for the Windows 0.2.24 installers, so nothing here is mistaken for coverage
verified: NSIS: real install 21,332 ms and uninstall 1,221 ms on marenben session 7; program dir, uninstall entry, start menu and desktop shortcut all removed; user PATH unchanged; no leftovers
NSIS ordering: NSIS_HOOK_PREUNINSTALL runs at the top of Section Uninstall (line 830) while every DeleteRegKey sits at 863 or later, so the revoke precedes registration removal
MSI: builds and packs raw0 with ICE validation passing
MSI: eight component registry values land under HKCU\Software\gz ers\OpenCodeX Desktop\023\Components after the escaping fix
MSI: from a clean state, install exit 0 (11 files, registration created) and uninstall exit 0 leaves leftoverFiles=0, registration 0, no shortcuts, PATH untouched

MSI: with an injected failing ocxd (return 7), the uninstall aborts at 1603 before InstallInitialize, with FileRemove/RegDeleteValue/RegDeleteKey/ProductUnpublish all 0, and ARP plus HKCU product records preserved 1->1
MSI: earlier evidence shows the revoke custom action is invoked as ocxd.exe --uninstall-terminal-cli --confirm and completes before RemoveFiles

notVerified.item: revoke actually removing a registered terminal entry
notVerified.why: every run so far installed without a terminal entry registered, so ocxd took its pristine short-circuit; the invocation and its ordering are proven, the removal of a live entry is not
notVerified.note: exercising it requires enabling the terminal entry through the product itself, which rewrites the user PATH and creates a shim; on this host the daily account uses 0.2.22 and should not be put at risk
notVerified.risk: HIGH - touches the current user's PATH

notVerified.item: marenben desktop acceptance of the fixed package
notVerified.why: the fixed-package install/uninstall was driven from the 15119 session; marenben session 7 was used only for the earlier pre-fix NSIS run
notVerified.note: needs an administrator to lift DisableMSI while that desktop is signed in, plus a collection step because marenben's profile is not readable from the ordinary token
notVerified.risk: MEDIUM - needs interactive session plus policy change
